hotspots.title: Hungarian Orban Ex-Minister Buried Cash Corruption Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian authorities seized nearly $20 million in illicit cash hidden in forests and farms during a corruption investigation involving former minister Miklós Seszták. The discovery has ignited massive political fallout, with both opposition leaders and Fidesz coalition allies demanding Seszták's immediate resignation.
hotspots.affect: The visual imagery of millions in cash unburied from forests creates an explosive moral corruption scandal that puts Orbán's political network under extreme siege.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal spearheaded a massive rally in Murcia to kick off the final push for the November 29 elections, framing the vote as a choice between 'Spain or the mafia.' The party is heavily promoting its core platform of national priority, economic deregulation, and strict remigration policies.
hotspots.affect: The coverage mobilizes deep populist fervor through existential framing and aggressive anti-immigrant rhetoric ahead of upcoming election polls.

hotspots.title: AfD Nominates Thomas Berthold for Bundespräsident
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) has nominated former 1990 soccer World Cup champion and prominent anti-lockdown critic Thomas Berthold for German Federal President. The nomination has drawn sharp condemnation from mainstream political parties while showcasing AfD's strategy of fielding anti-establishment figures.
hotspots.affect: Selecting a high-profile Querdenker figure for head of state serves as a direct provocation against the political establishment, driving sharp polarized contention.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Ratifies 2027 Reelection Bid
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei explicitly announced his intention to seek re-election in 2027 during a public address at the Casa Rosada museum opening. Challenging doubters directly, Milei outlined aggressive economic trade expansion targets through 2031 while asserting his leadership over the coalition.
hotspots.affect: Milei's combative declaration projects aggressive political triumph and ideological expansionism, stirring passionate debate across Argentine political media.

hotspots.title: Howard Lutnick Nvidia Export Probe & Firing Crisis
hotspots.blurb: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick remains under intense parliamentary and media fire over unauthorized Nvidia AI chip sales to China. Opposition lawmakers and critics continue demanding his immediate removal, citing severe risks to national security.
hotspots.affect: Allegations of high-level national security compromises generate persistent outrage and high-stakes administrative crisis framing.
